title: A geometric shape regularity effect in the human brain: MEG dataset

funding_references.funder_name: Collège de France to Stanislas Dehaene

description: This magnetoencephalography (MEG) dataset comprises recordings from 20 adult participants during the perception of geometric shapes, collected to investigate the neural mechanisms underlying human perception and recognition of regular geometric forms such as hexagons, triangles, and quadrilaterals. The study employs MEG to characterize brain dynamics and regional activation patterns in response to geometric regularities. Complementary functional MRI data from the same study are available separately at https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds006010. The dataset supports investigation of how discrete geometric features and visual regularities engage specialized brain systems involved in mathematical and symbolic processing.
methods_description: MEG data were acquired during visual perception tasks involving geometric shapes (hexagons, triangles, quadrilaterals) and other visual categories from 20 adult participants. Data were anonymized and defaced using mne_bids (version 0.16.0) with shuffled participant order, modified dates, and stripped gender information. Pre-processing was performed using mne-bids-pipeline with a custom configuration file.
